definition: extra work after normal working hours
description: A large, empty open-plan office in an old brick building late at night, dark outside the tall windows. Every desk is empty except one, where a young woman in a cream blouse sits alone, writing on papers, surrounded by piles of documents, sticky notes, a mug and a takeaway box; her jacket hangs on the chair. She keeps working, then rests her head on her hand and rubs her temple, tired. Far in the background a cleaner with a trolley and a security guard stand by the lit exit.

taps.phrase: to work overtime at her desk

es.answer: Está haciendo horas extra en su mesa.
